exposure: Late preterm birth (34 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation)
cohort: 56,160 Late preterm singleton neonates born between 2013 and 2017, from the Japan Society of Obstetrics and Gynecology Successive Pregnancy Birth Registry System
finding: Over half of late preterm neonates were low birth weight, and several modifiable and non-modifiable maternal factors were independently associated with low birth weight in this population.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was independently associated with low birthweight in late preterm singleton neonates.
